# Prismbee

> Prismbee is a digital growth agency for brands in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Europe. It combines video editing, social media content and management, and web design and development into one growth system that turns attention into revenue. Website: https://www.prismbee.site

## Services

- [Video Editing Services](https://www.prismbee.site/services/video-editing): High-retention commercial video editing, Reels production, and 3D motion design for brands and creators, with hooks engineered to captivate audiences in the first 3 seconds.
- [Social Media Management and Content Services](https://www.prismbee.site/services/social-media-management): Multi-platform organic social media management across TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, including Reels production, content calendars, community growth, and monthly ROI analytics.
- [Web Design and Development Services](https://www.prismbee.site/services/web-design): Bespoke, high-speed websites and landing pages built on modern architectures and engineered to convert traffic into qualified leads and paying clients.
- [All Services](https://www.prismbee.site/services): The full capability list, including brand scaling and identity systems (logo suites, color palettes, typography systems, and brand guidelines).

Supplementary service: Meta ads management is available as an add-on to social media management engagements. It is not sold as a standalone service line.

## Packages

Prismbee works in three packages — Starter, Growth, and Authority. All packages are priced on custom scope; there is no public price list. A written quote with deliverables, timelines, and revision rounds is provided after a discovery call.

- [Packages](https://www.prismbee.site/packages): Starter (brand identity setup, 1 platform organic social management, 5-page web platform, monthly analytics report), Growth (full brand identity system, 3-platform social management, web platform plus landing pages, Reels and video production, daily community management), Authority (premium brand system, full multi-platform management, custom web application, studio video production, dedicated senior account manager).

## Process

- [How It Works](https://www.prismbee.site/how-it-works): Prismbee's four-stage process — discovery, strategy, build, and scaling. Timelines and revision rounds are agreed in writing in the project scope before work starts.
